metaDescription: Order custom 150-200 page lanyards and badges for secure ID access. Perfect for events or daily use. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 150-200 page lanyards and badges are designed for high-traffic environments where you need to accommodate thick ID cards, access passes, or event credentials. The reinforced stitching and durable materials, like the 1" knit-in or nylon web options, ensure they hold up under daily use without stretching or fraying. Whether for a corporate conference or ongoing employee security, these lanyards provide reliable support for multiple pages while keeping your branding visible.
heroAltText: Custom 150-200 page lanyards and badges with reinforced stitching and secure badge holders for bulk orders.
